terms_check.decision: Proceeded with targeted fetches; judgment flagged for the lead. The Terms ban crawling/spidering (systematic link-following traversal, by manual or automated means), not automated access as such, and both robots.txt files permit the article paths (help centre Crawl-delay 1). This task made 41 requests (40 public pages, of which 2 robots.txt and 2 sitemaps, plus 1 image), one request each, at least 3.5 s apart, by curl with a browser User-Agent, with no link-following beyond reading two sitemaps once to find article URLs; that was treated as retrieval rather than crawling. No login, no account, no API, no scrapling stealthy-fetch (the Terms do not expressly allow automated access), no Firecrawl. Order of events: robots.txt (both), the www sitemap (to locate the Terms) and the Terms were fetched first; all rule pages after the clause was read. If the lead reads section 28 as forbidding this, every quote here can be traced to the E.12 raw pages (reports/stage_e12_briefs/topstep_pages/, 9 articles fetched 2026-10-03) or must be marked UNSOURCED.

prohibited.quote: Repeatedly trading aggressively, hitting the Maximum Loss Limit (MLL) in one account, then switching to another account and repeating. The goal is to run high-risk attempts until a large win occurs. This exploits risk parameters and is not permitted.
prohibited.bot_implication: A bot must not run a blow-up-and-rotate funnel: high-risk attempts that hit the MLL and are immediately repeated on the next account.

prohibited.practice: Intentionally depleting a Live Funded Account
prohibited.quote: Deliberately drawing down a Live Funded Account® (LFA) balance to force a failure. Not permitted.
prohibited.bot_implication: Out of bot scope (no API on Live); a trader must not drain an LFA to return to XFAs.

prohibited.quote: Using software, AI, ultra-high speed systems, or mass data entry that manipulates, abuses, or provides an unfair advantage on the platform or in the program.
prohibited.bot_implication: The bot's edge must come from market prediction, not from speed, order volume or platform behaviour.

prohibited.quote: Executing trades in a way that contradicts how trading actually works in the applicable futures markets, or in a way that creates justified concern that Topstep may suffer financial or other harm.
prohibited.bot_implication: Backtest P&L must be achievable live; any result relying on SIM-only fills is at risk of being voided.

prohibited.practice: Trading outside the best bid or offer
prohibited.quote: Placing orders at prices outside the current best bid or offer.
prohibited.bot_implication: Order prices must be at or inside the current BBO; the bot must not rest marketable orders through the book or post away-from-touch fills that SIM would fill.

prohibited.practice: Maximum position size into major news
prohibited.quote: Purposefully trading your full Maximum Position Size directly into a scheduled major news event.
prohibited.bot_implication: Before scheduled major releases (e.g. 7:30 AM CT employment, 1:00 PM CT FOMC) the bot must hold less than its full Maximum Position Size.

prohibited.quote: Running scalping algorithms designed to exploit unrealistic SIM fills
prohibited.bot_implication: No scalping logic whose edge depends on SIM fill mechanics.

prohibited.quote: Making hundreds of rapid trades to take advantage of preferential queue position in SIM
prohibited.bot_implication: Keep trade counts far below hundreds per day; no queue-position strategies.

prohibited.quote: Initiating reckless trades in gapped markets to profit from stray fills — these are improbable in live markets
prohibited.bot_implication: Do not fire orders into gaps or halts to catch stray fills.

prohibited.quote: Repeatedly exploiting the relative lack of slippage in SIM to achieve impossible stop-loss execution
prohibited.bot_implication: Simulated stops must carry live-like slippage; the strategy must not depend on SIM's slippage-free stops.

prohibited.practice: SIM fill exploitation: tight brackets / auto-breakeven
prohibited.quote: Using tight brackets or auto-breakeven to take advantage of favorable SIM fills
prohibited.bot_implication: Avoid very tight bracket and auto-breakeven management whose results depend on SIM fills.

prohibited.quote: The behaviors above are intentional and systematic — usually hundreds or thousands of trades per day, with average durations measured in seconds, not minutes.
prohibited.bot_implication: Average holding times should be minutes or longer and daily trade counts low.

prohibited.quote: Taking advantage of the simulated environment to gain an edge in the Trading Combine® is not permitted. By way of example, slippage, preferential order in the queue, market gaps, and high volume of trades within short periods of time are areas you are not permitted to take advantage of in the Trading Combine®.
prohibited.bot_implication: Same constraint stated contractually; violations can void a pass.

prohibited.quote: If you are found to have profited from taking advantage of the simulated environment to gain an edge in your Trading Combine® at any time you have graduated past the Trading Combine®, or otherwise deemed to have engaged in other Prohibited Conduct (defined below) you will not be entitled to receive any withdrawals from any other account maintained with Topstep, all of which will be forfeited and closed immediately.
prohibited.bot_implication: One finding can forfeit withdrawals on every account; the simulator should treat a finding as total loss across all accounts.

prohibited.quote: Trading activity in the Trading Combine® that knowingly or unknowingly circumvents targets and rules or generates profits that could not otherwise be achieved in live market trading, is a violation of the Terms.
prohibited.bot_implication: Rule-gaming patterns (e.g. engineering exactly-at-limit consistency days) may be judged circumvention even when unintentional.

prohibited.practice: High-frequency / short-term trades and opposite positions (Terms §27)
prohibited.quote: Performing, alone or in concert with any other persons, including between connected accounts, or accounts held with different Topstep Parties, trades, or combinations of trades, the purpose of which is to manipulate, abuse, or give User an unfair advantage while using the Site or Services, for example, by engaging in any short term or high frequency trades or simultaneously entering into opposite positions;
prohibited.bot_implication: No HFT and no simultaneous opposite positions across connected accounts.

prohibited.quote: Custom automated strategies and bots are allowed via the TopstepX / ProjectX API, subject to standard platform rules and our prohibition on highfrequency trading (HFT).
prohibited.bot_implication: Bots are allowed but must not be high-frequency; no numeric HFT threshold is published.

prohibited.quote: Cross-account hedging (single-user) — holding opposite positions across multiple accounts simultaneously
prohibited.bot_implication: All accounts run by the bot must hold the same direction in MES/ES (and correlated index products) at every moment; flatten before reversing.

prohibited.quote: Opposing positions are prohibited even if the overlap is brief or unintentional.
prohibited.bot_implication: A copier/bot reversal that briefly leaves one account long and another short is a violation; confirmed violations are final and closed accounts lose payouts.

prohibited.quote: Coordinated trading — performing trades in concert with others (including unconnected accounts or third parties) to pool risk, hedge aggregate positions, or trade the same or opposite strategy simultaneously
prohibited.bot_implication: The bot must not be shared with or mirrored by other people's accounts.

prohibited.practice: Same strategy in concert with others (Terms §27)
prohibited.quote: In concert with others, including between unconnected accounts and third parties, performing the same trading strategy (i.e., performing the same trades in the same time increments), opposite strategy, or other activity meant to pool or hedge risk of the aggregate, unconnected accounts;
prohibited.bot_implication: Selling or sharing the bot's signals to other Topstep traders risks a violation for all of them.

prohibited.quote: Price exploitation — strategies designed to exploit errors in price display or data feed delays
prohibited.bot_implication: No latency-arbitrage or stale-quote logic.

prohibited.quote: Using an external or slow data feed to trade
prohibited.bot_implication: Signals may use external data, but order decisions must not exploit a feed that differs from or lags TopstepX's prices (Terms §27 wording: 'Performing trades using an external or slow Data feed;').

prohibited.quote: Disruptive practices — including spoofing
prohibited.bot_implication: No orders placed without intent to execute; no layering.

prohibited.quote: Exploiting platform deficiencies — using instruments or methods that misuse bugs, errors, or deficiencies in the platform
prohibited.bot_implication: Do not depend on platform quirks (e.g. liquidation timing, copier behaviour).

prohibited.practice: Circumventing geographic or technical restrictions; VPN/VPS
prohibited.quote: All trading activity must originate from your personal device. The use of VPS, VPNs, and remote servers is prohibited by Topstep's Terms of Use. Running automation on a VPS can result in account suspension or removal from the program.
prohibited.bot_implication: The bot must place orders from the trader's own machine, not a VPS or cloud server; a server may only log and analyse.

prohibited.quote: Holding a position within 2% of a product’s price lock limit
prohibited.bot_implication: The bot must flatten MES before price is within 2% of the CME price limit.

prohibited.quote: Trading on behalf of others — including sharing incentives as part of any business arrangement
prohibited.bot_implication: Only the account holder's own accounts; no managed accounts.

prohibited.practice: Excessive purchases of Combines or Resets
prohibited.quote: Excessive purchases of Trading Combines or Resets
prohibited.bot_implication: A high-volume buy-and-reset funnel is itself Prohibited Conduct and an FTP trigger; no threshold is published.

prohibited.quote: Activating and losing many Express Funded Accounts in a short period of time
prohibited.bot_implication: Rapid XFA churn leads to the Slowdown Path (no new Combines, Resets or B2F) or the Corrective Path (all accounts closed, pending payouts denied).

prohibited.quote: Excessive use of Express Funded Accounts® (XFAs) and trading irresponsibly within them
prohibited.bot_implication: Running the 5-XFA maximum with reckless sizing puts standing at risk.

prohibited.practice: Multiple MLL hits in one day (RTP trigger)
prohibited.quote: Multiple accounts hit the Maximum Loss Limit in one day
prohibited.bot_implication: Copier-linked accounts that blow up together on one day can place the trader in RTP (forced DLL, Consistency-only XFAs).

prohibited.practice: Max position on most trades (RTP trigger)
prohibited.quote: You max position a majority of your trades
prohibited.bot_implication: The bot should not size at the Maximum Position Size on most trades.

prohibited.quote: You acknowledge that these standards are not met where you open substantially (i) larger position sizes compared to your other trades, or (ii) a smaller or larger number of positions compared to your other trades.
prohibited.bot_implication: Sizing should be stable from trade to trade; bursts of outsized trades breach the stated standard.

prohibited.quote: if you place an unusually large number of orders for the Services within an unreasonably short period of time, as determined in the sole discretion of Topstep, we reserve the right to suspend any further orders of the Services by you.
prohibited.bot_implication: Purchase rate, not trading orders: the 'orders for the Services' are purchases of Combines, Resets and related services; buy them at a modest rate, since Topstep can suspend further purchases it deems unusually many in a short time (lead fix, ruling RR-4).

prohibited.quote: All positions MUST be closed prior to 3:10 PM CT or prior to the market close, whichever is sooner.
prohibited.bot_implication: The bot must be flat before 15:10 CT (or earlier holiday closes); no overnight-into-settlement holds.

prohibited.quote: Errors corrected in under 10 seconds are ignored. Leave too many contracts on for 10+ seconds and your account may be reviewed.
prohibited.bot_implication: The bot must cap MES at 10 x the current tier's lots and correct any overage within 10 seconds.

prohibited.quote: Any other conduct that Topstep determines, at its sole discretion, is uncommercial, games the market, is not a viable strategy, or is not responsible trading
prohibited.bot_implication: Any strategy can be ruled out after the fact; the simulator should carry a non-zero ruling risk.

prohibited.quote: Delay or denial of a Payout request
prohibited.bot_implication: Payout requests are reviewed against Prohibited Conduct, Terms, Professional Behavior and Prohibited Strategies (S17) and can be denied.

prohibited.quote: All Trading Combines, Express Funded Accounts, and Live Funded Accounts must be under 1 Topstep profile.
prohibited.bot_implication: All bot accounts must sit under the trader's one profile.

prohibited.quote: Yes, with conditions. Topstep won't help set up or troubleshoot automated strategies, and no exceptions are made for errant trades or malfunctions.
